consultant.name: Daniel Deepak (Danny)
consultant.positioning: Before I spend a rupee, I find where the last one leaked.

stages.name: Measurement
stages.hint: Can the business see which rupee worked?

leaks.name: Miscounted conversions
leaks.short: The ad platform reports results the till never saw

leaks.name: Money on the wrong intent
leaks.short: Budget sits where it is easiest to spend, not where buyers convert

leaks.name: Post-click friction
leaks.short: Slow pages, long forms, broken booking paths

leaks.name: Invisible where buyers look
leaks.short: Missing from Maps, directories, brand search or page one

leaks.name: Price and distribution leakage
leaks.short: Your own inventory sold cheaper elsewhere

leaks.name: Lead-to-booking gap
leaks.short: Leads arrive; nobody converts them fast enough

leaks.name: Post-sale leakage
leaks.short: Returns, falling ticket size, no repeat

leaks.name: Not a marketing problem
leaks.short: The fix sits with ops, product or the shop floor

cases.name: TONI&GUY Bangalore
cases.role: Growth consultant: Google, Meta, GBP, web, reporting, booking app
cases.gradeNote: Ad exports joined to point-of-sale revenue by salon
cases.leak: Leads hit record volume while ticket size fell and no callback loop existed
cases.kpiText: salon revenue, Mar–Aug 2026 vs same six months of 2025 (₹16.10 Cr vs ₹14.04 Cr)

booking.t: No lead-to-booking view; callback automation proposed, not built

revenue.t: Average bill ₹2,813 vs ₹2,983 a year earlier

cases.name: MR Jewels
cases.role: Google Ads lead + business review across Shopify, Meta and Google
cases.gradeNote: Google exports reconciled to Shopify orders and billing
cases.leak: Google claimed 11.8× the company's monthly revenue; the real losses sat in the cart and in returns
cases.kpiText: showroom campaign CPC after one conversion-goal fix (₹38.60 → ₹13.13)

visibility.t: 66% of 8,396 feed SKUs never shown; 80.9% of spend on Shopping

revenue.t: 19.8% of gross reversed: ₹2.41 Cr in 12 months

measurement.t: ₹12.56 Cr conversion value vs ₹1.07 Cr real sales

cases.name: Elites Dental Care
cases.role: Audit, Business Profile rebuild, Search campaign rebuild
cases.gradeNote: Google Ads, GA4, Search Console and GBP data; no clinic revenue yet
cases.leak: ₹3,140 per booking: the clicks were fine, everything after the click was broken
cases.kpiText: cost per booking before the rebuild (₹25,122 for 8 bookings)

visibility.t: Not on page one for 'dental clinic tc palya'; no Practo listing

click.t: 2.6 s server response; 96% of spend on mobile

enquiry.t: 4-step booking; widget blank after an expired SSL certificate

revenue.t: Attendance and treatment value not yet shared

repeat.t: 4.9★ from 271 reviews, owner replies to all

measurement.t: Every booking valued at ₹1; GA4 sees ~1 in 6 ad clicks

cases.name: Resort & events venue
cases.period: Audit 25–26 Sep 2026 · Business Profile work from 28 Sep
cases.gradeNote: Outside-in audit plus Business Profile performance data; no ad or booking data yet
cases.leak: Guests want to buy; the journey ends at 'Enquire' while the same room sells 55% cheaper on an OTA
cases.kpiText: room price on an OTA via Google Hotels vs the resort's own site (₹1,780 vs ₹3,999)
cases.objective: Direct bookings and paid day-out tickets

enquiry.t: No book-now, no online payment; 'Enquire' only

booking.t: Profile calls down 65% May→Sep while directions rose

revenue.t: Own rooms on Yatra at ₹1,780 vs ₹3,999 direct

measurement.t: No Ads conversion tag, no Meta Pixel; bookings confirmed by hand

cases.name: Foremost Public Adjusters
cases.role: Paid search audit, SEO fixes, campaign build, brand investigation
cases.gradeNote: Google Ads and Search Console exports; no claim or fee data
cases.leak: Lead cost swung on post-click conversion, not budget, and the firm had stopped appearing for its own name
cases.kpiText: live keywords that were branded: the brand campaign had been paused in a restructure

visibility.t: 23% impression share; 0 of 247 live keywords branded

click.t: 88 paid clicks landed on the homepage

enquiry.t: Desktop CPL $398 vs mobile $93; May CVR fell on flat spend

revenue.t: Fees per settled claim not supplied

measurement.t: Lead tracking in place; two exports disagree (56 vs 48 leads)

cases.name: EveryWatch
cases.gradeNote: Monthly series reconstructed in an earlier case study; raw exports not in the repo
cases.leak: Acquisition scaled; returning users stayed near one in ten
cases.kpiText: monthly new users, Jan 2024 (9,113) to May 2025 (182,782), GA4

booking.t: Lead-to-subscriber data not in the record

revenue.t: 'Revenue' was leads × ~$15 assumed value, not sales

measurement.t: Reported CVR above 100% in peak months

cases.name: Swift Restoration
cases.gradeNote: Site crawl, Ahrefs, SERP and ad checks; no lead or revenue data
cases.leak: A 5.0★ operator with no service pages, no location pages and no Local Services Ads
cases.kpiText: service or location pages on the site at audit (service cards linked to '#')

visibility.t: Domain Rating 3.2; no Local Services Ads
